metadata.title: torch.add and torch.sub return incorrect results when computing complex numbers containing inf on both CPU and GPU

bug_description:
torch.add produces incorrect results when adding complex tensors containing infinite values.

Example:
(inf+1j) + (inf+2j)

Expected:
inf+3j

Actual:
inf+nanj


Reproduction:

import torch

a = torch.tensor(
    complex(float("inf"),1),
    dtype=torch.complex128
)

b = torch.tensor(
    complex(float("inf"),2),
    dtype=torch.complex128
)

result = torch.add(a,b)


Observed:

CPU:
tensor(inf+nanj)

CUDA:
tensor(inf+nanj)


Trigger Condition:

- API: torch.add
- dtype: complex128
- input contains Inf values
- CPU or CUDA backend


Bug Pattern Candidate:

Complex floating point special-value handling failure.

Potential Harness Strategy:

Generate complex tensors containing:
- inf real component
- inf imaginary component
- combinations of finite and infinite values

Compare output against mathematically expected complex arithmetic.


Oracle:

Incorrect result comparison.


Research Value:

High.

This bug represents numerical correctness failures caused by special floating point values.
